# Ordinary MAP: upstream permissions and missing inputs

Status: revised dependency proposal; no numerical permission granted.
D001–D005 remain open in the [ledger](SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md).
These replace the first-method route entries in the r0.1 JINC proposal; the
historical JINC control retains its own separate requirements.

| ID | Required object and owner | Already authoritative | Exact outstanding binding | Blocked use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| U01 | Original measured ancestry and RTC/CAL/AST realization; producer owners | Frozen FRUIT requires exact ancestry and pre-removal input. MAP's inherited PTC signal is calibrated-x-derived nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent, top-of-atmosphere point-source-equivalent mJy/beam with its fixed nominal beam/template and spectral/calibration lineage. | One observation and exact original input/calibration/RTC/geometry records; pre-removal product, scale, reference/gauge, timing, detector/sample axes, support and validity. No observation is selected here. | Numerical iteration or physical-parent response. |
| U02 | Residual PTC transformation and MAP-facing coefficient/QC family; PTC owner | Frozen PTC application science and `SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.1` are fixed. Modal application coordinates and analysis/gridding coefficients are separate. | Exact cleaning/centering/grouping/rank/support, state learning/application rule, PTC-owner-selected MAP-facing coefficient family and compatible value/QC generation. Frozen MAP supplies no unity, sensitivity, scatter or precision default. | Residual operation and numerical MAP contribution. |
| U03 | FRUIT rejoin-to-MAP handoff; FRUIT and affected PTC/MAP/AST owners | Ordinary MAP consumes the exact realized PTC product with its coefficient/QC and same-stable-RTC-sample AST identity. | An explicit permitted relation from residual PTC output through rejoin to the MAP input, retained/recomputed coefficients and coordinates. Determine whether an exact existing authority suffices or a successor is required. The altered descendant is not automatically the unchanged PTC product. | Admission of a rejoined signal under ordinary PTC-to-MAP authority. |
| U04 | Forward ordinary MAP and support policy; MAP owner | Frozen v0.1/r0.7.1 defines positive-coefficient normalization and `SCI-MAP:one_hot_containing_pixel@1`, half-open boundaries and support-authorized rows. Exact `map_upstream_admission@2` registration/source binding exists. | Exact realized U02 family and admitted effective support population/policy, including the numerical `coverage_cut` state/value. Frozen MAP leaves those numerical gates open. No threshold, positive-weight precision claim or implementation conformity is supplied here. | Numerical MAP realization and support resolution. |
| U05 | Feedback projection and selector companions; FRUIT and respective producers | Forward one-hot placement is already MAP science; the reverse feedback projection is not selected. MAP carries response and uncertainty states, which may honestly be unavailable. | Explicit model-to-removal and model-to-rejoin maps, additive conversions, coordinate/grid associations and support/failure rules. A matching piecewise-constant rejoin projection is an example, not a decision. Every selector-required RMS/noise, template/kernel or coefficient-derived quantity needs its exact producer, availability and meaning. | Numerical selection/projection, model round-trip identity or companion-dependent claims. |
| U06 | Response/uncertainty methods; FRUIT and NOI | Frozen seven FRUIT response roles and uncertainty grammar remain. MAP separates fixed-state response, PTC procedure response and re-resolved PTC+MAP response. Unavailable covariance is not zero and positive coefficient is not precision. | Exact perturbation domain/law and fixed/rerun maps/state; recurrence/terminal conditioning; separately approved NOI method, zero-law action and member parity where requested. Historical residual noise maps establish none of these by name. | Numerical transfer, variance, significance, coverage or source-free claims. |
| U07 | Pointing/source-inference use and MAP exposure roles; named owners | Downstream fitness is separate. MAP carries unique-original footprint exposure under exact original ALIGN-grid AST coordinates, distinct from RTC-grid signal coordinates. Rejoin and repeated iterations create no exposure. | A later exact source/pointing target/estimator and its response/uncertainty dependencies; required original-lineage and original-coordinate bindings and availability. | Pointing accuracy, recovered measured sky/modes, added exposure or a policy recommendation. |
| U08 | Historical control and candidate execution identities; project/scientific owners | Historical control remains mandatory and unchanged. The new ordinary-MAP candidate has a different route identity. | Bind each separately: executable/environment, ordered configuration, original inputs, initial/causal/stochastic state, extent and output identity. A later experiment must distinguish mapmaker effects from feedback effects, rather than treating a MAP-versus-JINC difference as FRUIT benefit. Exact design/population/tolerances require separate approval. | Reproducible numerical control, paired comparison or attribution of scientific benefit. |

The simpler forward estimator removes JINC's signed-kernel numerical
parameters/adequacy and gridding/interpolation pairing from the *first method's*
scope. It does not remove FRUIT projection questions, producer permissions,
model companions, support, response or uncertainty. JINC requirements remain
with the historical control and a separately approved later specialization.
No MAP/PTC/NOI successor, experiment or qualification is authorized here.
